description:
Specification: extend AttachDocuments output schema to carry the validated operation and authorized Records; retain add/remove/replace ordering and signed-identity deduplication in a small pure reducer. Preserve batch atomicity, provenance/current source read checks, nil-identity denial and literal trusted bypass. Plan trusted native request checks without introducing a replacement request registry. Keep existing delivery behavior functional until the atomic consumer switch in the next child; do not leave an intermediate revision that silently drops files.
Files: lib/zaq/agent/tools/data_source/attach_documents.ex; lib/zaq/agent/opaque_aliases.ex if a schema-based output-expansion helper is needed; corresponding tests. Keep GetDocument and registry key unchanged.
Tests before implementation: operation/Record round trips, real GetDocument authorization, invalid or forged batch, absent actor/context, explicit bypass, same-identity refresh, malformed/missing/foreign aliases. Verify output-schema conversion does not lose validated Records.
Action reuse: extend existing Action and OpaqueAliases; call GetDocument through Jido.Exec, reuse Record provenance/authorization. Input operation+Records; output authorized instruction; errors mutate no selection and perform no delivery/deletion. Alias expansion is local-only and shares existing scoped store/schema traversal; no new Action or token store.
Branches: add/remove/replace/clear, authorized/denied, valid/invalid provenance and aliases.
Mocking: external provider edges only; keep internal validation and dispatch real.
Docs: update Action/helper moduledocs for the final contract as part of the consumer switch; track interim staging honestly.
Acceptance: tested instruction/reducer and alias expansion ready for StreamEvents, no current-flow regression.

Required policies: docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/services/agent.md, docs/testing-approach.md; documentation edits additionally follow docs/documentation.md. No implementation authorized yet.
title: [zaq-aa6.2] Prepare validated attachment instruction results and alias expansion
